# d3-thermometer

- Component version: 1.2.0
- Source: https://github.com/davidbanksnz/d3-thermometer
- Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3-thermometer@1.2.0/thermometer.min.js
- Runtime dependency: D3 4.13.0 (`d3.min.js` in this directory)
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- Runtime: loaded locally and on demand when the POWER tab is opened.

The W pillar uses the library's SVG thermometer component. The application maps
the CRM's five honest warmth classifications to a categorical scale; it does not
invent a numeric warmth score.
